title: PQ-Box 50: The Mobile and Universal Power Quality Analyzer

blocks.text: The perfect tool for energy management audits to ISO 50001. Our universal Class A power quality network analyzer, PQ-Box 50, has been developed for wide-ranging use and comes with an integrated power unit and robust housing, all in a small space. This network analyzer is for universal deployment and is ideal for mobile measurements in harsh environments or where space is highly limited.
